about.title: A race for everyone
about.introFallback: Candeonato is a racing series created to enjoy iRacing as a community without turning every corner into a battle.
about.body: We all compete in the Mazda MX-5 on free tracks with a fixed setup. The priority is clean racing, learning together and ending the night eager to race again.
about.quote: We compete on track. Away from it, we are a team.
about.imageAlt: Glowing side illustration of the Mazda MX-5 used in Candeonato
about.caption: One car for everyone. The difference is how we share the track.

requirements.title: Technical sheet
requirements.intro: Everything you need to hit the track. No surprise purchases and no hidden advantages.
requirements.simulatorDescription: You need an active account and access to the simulator.
requirements.carDescription: The included vehicle we will use throughout the event.
requirements.setupDescription: Everyone competes with the same settings.
requirements.tracksDescription: The final selection will be announced on Discord.
requirements.freeText: There is no Candeonato registration fee.
requirements.placesText: They will be assigned by registration order and validation.
requirements.discordText: You will receive access, tracks and the final schedule there.

schedule.intro: Online iRacing event. The meeting time and briefing will be confirmed to registered participants via Discord.

rules.title: Track code
rules.intro: A few very clear rules: compete without forgetting there is a person behind every car.
rules.cleanText: Defend your position respectfully, leave space and avoid unnecessary contact.
rules.impactText: Deliberate hits or retaliation may result in exclusion from future Candeonatos.
rules.respectText: Anger, insults and disrespect have no place in this event.
rules.briefingText: Check Discord before the race and follow the organisers' instructions.
rules.pointsText: Standings, points and any sporting penalties follow the system published by Fat Cat Race. This website displays those results without recalculating them.
rules.principle: The goal is not to win at any cost. It is for everyone to cross the finish line.

registration.intro: Complete your details. The organisers will review your application and send you access, the final schedule and tracks through Discord.
